main_text.p: standam putat, cùm in speciebus qualitas confiderari sola possit: quam solam spectari in hac re Paulus apertissimè tradit in L. sedsi meus, 26. de acqu.rer.dom. Videamus tamen, ecquid ista tota controuersia verius hoc modo disceptari possit, si dicamus, species ex iis reb. factas quæ in suo genere functionē recipiunt, idcirco effectoris esse: quia cum aliæ res reddū tur, eadem ipse reddi videntur. factas ex aliis, ideo eiusdē esse, quia materia suo domino perijt, abestque. L. Mulieris, 13. de verb.sign. L. quid tū, 10. §. 3. D. quemadmodum usuf.

page.notes: The first word is a partly ornamented initial; read as "standam". The word "sedsi" (printed "fedsi") and "spectari" (printed with a ligature) are doubtful readings. "eiusdē" and "reddū" use abbreviation marks as printed. The final catchword "suf." is the continuation of "u-", shown with long s as plain s. The handwritten mark in the right margin is not printed text and is left out.
